form.label: Darkmoon — Remediation & Retest
form.description: Remediation pull-requests (Pro) and retest verdicts. PR bodies and finding evidence are never ingested — state and references only.

search.query: `darkmoon_index` sourcetype=darkmoon:pr | stats latest(state) as state by pr_id | stats count by state
`darkmoon_index` sourcetype=darkmoon:retest verdict=* | timechart count by verdict

`darkmoon_index` sourcetype=darkmoon:pr | stats latest(state) as state latest(provider) as provider latest(repo) as repo latest(number) as number latest(confidence) as confidence latest(campaign_id) as campaign_id latest(url) as url latest(_time) as last by pr_id | eval last=strftime(last,"%F %T") | table pr_id provider repo number state confidence campaign_id last url | sort - last

`darkmoon_index` sourcetype=darkmoon:retest | stats latest(verdict) as verdict latest(base_status) as base_status latest(new_status) as new_status latest(severity) as severity latest(target) as target latest(_time) as last by finding_id title | eval last=strftime(last,"%F %T") | table finding_id title severity target base_status new_status verdict last | sort verdict
